speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your cough feels, and does it produce any mucus? If so, what color is the mucus and how much do you cough up? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Right lower lobe consolidation consistent with a possible pneumonia. No pleural effusion noted.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That confirms a lung infection; have you experienced any fever, chills, or night sweats recently? Also, tell me if you feel particularly fatigued or have lost any weight lately.

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you had any recent close contact with someone who had a respiratory illness, and do you have any known allergies or asthma history? REQUEST TEST: Sputum_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any pleuritic chest pain, or does the cough worsen when you lie down or change position? Also, have you had any difficulty swallowing or experiencing heartburn recently? REQUEST TEST: Sputum_Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: The second sputum culture also came back normal, which is interesting given the consolidation on your X-ray. Do you have a history of acid reflux or heartburn, and does your cough improve when you take an antacid? REQUEST TEST: Acid_Reflux_Symptom_Index

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your X-ray shows pneumonia but your cultures and reflux tests are normal, have you been taking antibiotics, or do you have any history of tuberculosis or immunodeficiency? REQUEST TEST: Tuberculosis_Spot_Test

Also, do you smoke, or have you been exposed to secondhand smoke or industrial dust recently?

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Atypical Pneumonia (likely Mycoplasma pneumoniae)
